about: By-eye check of A0 (pre-registered): the 50 unsupported mentions per model sampled by object_precision.py (seed 0, results/a0/spot_check_<tag>.csv), each judged on the 8 describer frames of its window at 160x120. One rater (Claude), 3 Nov 2026. Codes: V = the object is visible (real, the narration just does not name it); I = not visible in any frame (invented); N = named inside a negation ('I do not interact with any doors'); T = the word is not that object (colour, verb, brand: 'orange shirt', 'see', 'Cow Tales'); U = cannot tell from the frames.
